maker: Siri Inc. (from SRI International), then Apple
summary: The voice assistant that came out of an SRI International research project. Apple bought it and made it a headline feature of the iPhone 4S, putting a talking assistant in millions of pockets years before chatbots.

events.note: Apple buys Siri Inc., which had spun out of SRI International.
Launches on the iPhone 4S, labelled beta.

events.label: ChatGPT link
events.note: iOS 18 adds language-model features and a link to ChatGPT.

events.label: Gemini Siri
events.note: A Siri built on Google’s Gemini models is unveiled at WWDC.
